answer: Sybil farms often look dense but hollow: many edges, few real mutual checks. Require every high-centrality vertex in the attestation graph to publish a saffron work receipt—an epoch-bound hash of recent peer-verified outputs. Peers only count a vertex if three independent neighbors confirm the receipt and a local triangle closes. Hollow shells fail the triangle test and cannot mint identity weight, so cloned agents stall without recycled work.
